requirements.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:71-81 appends the mention on its own line after truncating content to MaxContentLength minus the suffix length; app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:83-102 validates the id (int cast, trim, /^[0-9]{17,20}$/D) and returns <@id>; config/services.php:40 wires services.discord.mention_id; .env.example:78-79, docs/ops/devops.md:70-79 and docs/ops/logging.md:83 document it. The null path at line 75 returns the original mb_substr, so no-mention behavior is unchanged.

conventions.evidence: Tests ship with the change (tests/Feature/DiscordOpsAlertTest.php:125-260); docs and CHANGELOG kept in sync (.env.example:79, docs/ops/devops.md:70, docs/ops/logging.md:83, CHANGELOG.md:18); the new const and private helper match sibling style (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:28,83, compare BearerLikePattern at line 26).

security.evidence: Only ASCII digits are accepted after trim (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:95-101), so @everyone, @here, embedded newlines and extra characters return null; non-string/non-int config returns null (87-93); the id is constrained to 17-20 digits so mention injection is impossible, and the webhook URL/secret handling is untouched.

tests.evidence: Pest tests cover the mention line (tests/Feature/DiscordOpsAlertTest.php:125), whitespace trimming (146), integer id (162), null/empty/no-mention (178), 11 invalid values including newline injection and 21-digit overflow (194), and the 1800-character truncation with the mention preserved (222).

simplicity.evidence: Reuses existing MaxContentLength and safe(); adds only one small private method and one regex constant (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:28,83-102); no new abstraction or dependency.

readability.evidence: Small focused mention() with early returns and clear names (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:83-102); SnowflakePattern (line 28) mirrors the existing BearerLikePattern naming (line 26); no dead code or debugging.

scope.evidence: Every hunk serves the feature: DiscordOpsAlert, config/services.php, .env.example, the two required ops docs, CHANGELOG.md and the test file; no unrelated refactors.

review.summary: The change adds an optional DISCORD_MENTION_ID that is strictly validated as a 17-20 digit snowflake and appended to every Discord ops alert, reserving room so the mention survives the 1800-character truncation. It ships with thorough Pest coverage and updates .env.example, both ops docs and the changelog; the implementation is minimal and consistent with the existing class.
